entropy.name: Entropy
entropy.effect: Brandish: Distort all armaments. At your recovery, Distort all armaments that you Distorted this way.

heliana-yade-thriving.name: Heliana Yade
heliana-yade-thriving.effect: The first time you play an edict during your turn, Distort target armament an opponent wields.

heliana-yade-desperate.name: Heliana Yade
heliana-yade-desperate.effect: On Strike: If the defending player wields 5 or more Hazed Memories, that player puts their deck into their scrapyard.

pora-aliestrad-thriving.name: Pora Aliestrad
pora-aliestrad-thriving.effect: Drain: Distort an armament you wield.

pora-aliestrad-wounded.name: Pora Aliestrad
pora-aliestrad-wounded.effect: Whenever an armament you wield would Distort, you may return it to your hand instead.

pora-aliestrad-desperate.name: Pora Aliestrad
pora-aliestrad-desperate.effect: Whenever an armament you wield distorts, put the top 3 cards of your deck into your scrapyard and each opponent loses 1 health.

gro-thriving.name: Gro'
gro-thriving.effect: Whenever you Graft to a weapon, give that weapon +1 Temper.

gro-wounded.name: Gro'
gro-wounded.effect: Weapons you wield cannot be broken by effects as long as they have 3 or more acolytes grafted to it.

gro-desperate.name: Gro'
gro-desperate.effect: You can Graft acolytes to me. Whenever you graft to me, lose 2 health.

kreena-eldervyre-thriving.name: Kreena Eldervyre
kreena-eldervyre-thriving.effect: Whenever you graft, deal 1 damage to your opponent.

kreena-eldervyre-wounded.name: Kreena Eldervyre
kreena-eldervyre-wounded.effect: Drain: Your next Graft tests 0 resolve. Discard 1.

kreena-eldervyre-desperate.name: Kreena Eldervyre
kreena-eldervyre-desperate.effect: Test X: Graft X acolytes you wield to a weapon you wield and lose X health.

shiera-silkthroat-wounded.name: Shiera Silkthroat
shiera-silkthroat-wounded.effect: Acolytes with 2 or more indulgence counters on them can attack your opponent directly.

shiera-silkthroat-desperate.name: Shiera Silkthroat
shiera-silkthroat-desperate.effect: Break an acolyte you wield: Give all Indulgence counters it had to another acolyte you wield. Do this once each turn.

nine-lives-thriving.name: Nine Lives
nine-lives-thriving.effect: Whenever you indulge, also put a counter on me.

nine-lives-wounded.name: Nine Lives
nine-lives-wounded.effect: At your preparation you may draw 1 and put the top 1 card(s) of your deck into your scrapyard. If you don't create a random Withdrawal.

nine-lives-desperate.name: Nine Lives
nine-lives-desperate.effect: The first time your health is reduced to 0, Set your health to 1 instead.

kakandi-bloodbrood-wounded.name: Kakandi Bloodbrood
kakandi-bloodbrood-wounded.effect: The first time you show mercy each turn, show mercy an additional time.

kakandi-bloodbrood-desperate.name: Kakandi Bloodbrood
kakandi-bloodbrood-desperate.effect: On Attack: If the defending players health is equal to or less than your mercy, that player loses the game.

uldes-var-thriving.name: Uldes Var
uldes-var-thriving.effect: The first time you lose health during your turn, gain 1 resolve.

uldes-var-wounded.name: Uldes Var
uldes-var-wounded.effect: If your condition would worsen during your turn, target opponents condition worsens as well.

uldes-var-desperate.name: Uldes Var
uldes-var-desperate.effect: As long as you have 1 or less health, all weapons you wield have "On Strike: Defending player's condition worsens".

fleeting-visions.name: Fleeting Visions
fleeting-visions.effect: Each player draws an additional card during their draw phase. At each player's recovery, that player discards 1.

pale-glow.name: Pale Glow
pale-glow.effect: Each player's maximum resolve is increased by 1.

death-with-no-meaning.name: Death With No Meaning
death-with-no-meaning.effect: At any time a player may test 3 resolve to return a card from their scrapyard to their hand.

temptation-of-chaos.name: Temptation of Chaos
temptation-of-chaos.effect: All Weapons and Acolytes have +1 Attack.

unraveling.name: Unraveling
unraveling.effect: At the end of each players recovery, all armaments that player wields lose 1 Temper.

stinging-madness.name: Stinging Madness
stinging-madness.effect: Whenever a player draws a card outside of their draw phase, they lose 1 health.

overwhelming-dread.name: Overwhelming Dread
overwhelming-dread.effect: All Damage is Dealt as Dread instead.

existential-permanence.name: Existential Permanence
existential-permanence.effect: Whenever an armament is broken, shatter it instead.
